title: What is Homestead Tax Exemption
description:
Hello Texas Homeowners! Don’t forget to take advantage of the Homestead Tax Exemption available to you. This exemption can significantly reduce the taxable value of your primary residence, potentially saving you money on your property taxes. 

✅ Who qualifies?
Homeowners who occupy the property as their primary residence as of January 1st.
You must apply for the exemption if you’ve recently purchased or moved into your home.
